asset: Anime facial expression sheet for BRIMBOUND low-poly revision
initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production facial texture atlas for a low-poly cute anime fantasy game character, to be UV mapped onto an existing 3D head. This is a flat texture image, NOT a picture of heads or characters.

Create a square 2048x2048 2 by 2 grid of four face-only expression tiles. Each tile occupies precisely one quadrant, with identical eye, nose, mouth and eyebrow anchor positions in all four quadrants. No visible grid, no text, no borders, no head outlines, no ears, no hair, no hats, no necks. Fill the ENTIRE image edge-to-edge with exactly the same flat warm light peach skin color #E6B986. No shading or gradient on this skin background; keep at least 12% clean skin-colored margin within each quadrant. Only facial features are painted on that flat background.

Style: beautifully drawn clean anime/chibi JRPG face textures, bold dark brown upper eyelids, large appealing almond-shaped amber/brown eyes with cream whites, deep amber irises and crisp white highlights, expressive eyebrows, a tiny understated nose mark, and small expressive mouth. Gender-neutral young fantasy adventurer. Crisp hand-painted cel-shaded line art, readable at a distance. Subtle blush must be PAINTED into the image only. Avoid uncanny realism or giant baby eyes.

Fixed layout within EACH quadrant: eye centers at x=30% and x=70%, y=43%; each eye approximately 22% of tile width and 18% of tile height. Eyebrows centered at y=28%. Tiny nose mark at x=50%,y=58%. Mouth at x=50%,y=73%. Face features never reach tile edges.
Top left: warm confident friendly closed-mouth smile, open expressive eyes.
Top right: delighted joyful anime smile, wide sparkling eyes, open smiling mouth with a small cream upper tooth band.
Bottom left: determined battle expression, inward angled eyebrows, focused almond eyes, a small resolute smirk.
Bottom right: surprised expression, raised eyebrows, rounder open eyes, small open O mouth.
The four faces belong to the SAME character. Uniform background, exact even grid, consistent scale and alignment. No extra art, no shadows, no product mockup, no 3D, no watermarks.
final_edit_prompt:
Edit this four-expression texture atlas for direct use as an opaque game head texture.
Keep the exact four expressions, their eye and mouth positions, amber irises, clean anime linework, and even 2x2 layout.
CHANGE the background: it must be completely OPAQUE and solid warm light peach #E6B986, edge to edge, in all four quadrants. No transparency anywhere. No feathered outlines, no black backdrop, no halos around the faces. Remove the airbrushed brown facial skin shading so the skin surrounding every feature is the same uniform flat #E6B986 as all empty areas of the atlas. Preserve only eyes, eyebrows, tiny nose marks, mouths and restrained painted blush. No drawn head outlines, hair, ears, labels or grid lines. This is a flat, skin-colored UV texture atlas, not four floating face cutouts. Square 2048 x 2048.
